snippet.title: Fragment Collapse - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4156300/Fragment_Collapse/

Join the discord!
https://discord.gg/Qnc3jWTeEW

Follow me:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/barney_codes
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/user/BarneyCodes/

Fragment Collapse is a satisfying tile matching rogue-like deck-builder where you defragment your hard drive by matching clusters of files. Discover powerful cartridges to upgrade your computer, boost your files with enhancements and build massive combos for file-busting mayhem!

Music: Sweet 70s - Clement Panchout http://www.clementpanchout.com
